info.headline: Severe Thunderstorms
info.description: Damages to properties and settlements (formal and informal) due to wind and hail. Flooding of low-water bridges, roads and susceptible settlements. Disruptions to power supply and communications.
info.instruction: Seek safe shelter from hail and lightning. Do not seek shelter under trees or tall objects. Do not cross swollen rivers/streams and/or flooded roads and bridges. Drive carefully and keep a safe following distance. Stay away from flooded areas. Load WeatherSmart APP, scroll to last page and use two fingers to navigate storm tracking application.
